description: Declared mutants of the time-threads-trace plan. A mutant is killed only when its test run fails with the expected message (run_mutations.py).

mutants.what: A deadline wake may return up to 1 ms before the deadline
mutants.find: if (bounded && now >= deadline) return {WakeReason::Deadline, deadline, now, LateSince(deadline, now)};
mutants.replace: if (bounded && now + std::chrono::milliseconds(1) >= deadline) return {WakeReason::Deadline, deadline, now, LateSince(deadline, now)};
mutants.expect: CHECK\( wake.woke >= deadline \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: Notify signals the platform but never sets the latch
mutants.cases: *latches a notification sent before the wait*
mutants.expect: CHECK\( wake.reason == WakeReason::Notified \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A wait discards a notification sent before it started
mutants.replace:
const bool bounded = deadline != TimePoint::max();
    impl_->notified.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
mutants.cases: *latches a notification sent before the wait*
mutants.expect: CHECK\( wake.reason == WakeReason::Notified \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A wake leaves the latch set, so notifications never coalesce
mutants.expect: CHECK\( second.reason == WakeReason::Deadline \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A stop request sets the flag but does not wake the role's wait
mutants.cases: *a stop request wakes a role blocked in its wait*
mutants.expect: the stop request did not wake the role's wait

mutants.what: After a platform wake without the latch, the wait reports the deadline without re-reading the time base
mutants.expect: CHECK\( second.woke >= deadline \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A pending notification is consumed before a passed deadline is reported
mutants.expect: CHECK\( passed.reason == WakeReason::Deadline \) is NOT correct
